h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcap2p0-g0p15-20261023-2.hypothesis: Within the 300 m kernel, a dot pays credit only if it lands within ~3 px of a new-fault pixel. If the parent's lineament positions carry the ~100-300 m location error expected from 400 m flight-line spacing, then sliding each poorly-positioned dot onto the local maximum of the TMI/gravity horizontal gradient and detrended-elevation slope recover(s) credit that R0 loses to position error. Dose g=0.15 = only dots whose local edge maximum is at least that much stronger than their own pixel move.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcap2p0-g0p15-20261023-2.mechanism: Potential-field horizontal-gradient maxima and slope maxima are where the physical property contrast across a fault plane projects to the surface; the same construction that makes them edge detectors makes their maxima the best local estimate of the trace position. The DTI denominator is dominated by uncovered truth (|G|), so a dot 3-4 px off-trace earns nothing while a dot on the crest earns ~2-3 units of triangular-kernel credit against the same truth.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcap2p0-g0p15-20261023-2.non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts, intrusive margins, caldera ring fractures, palaeochannels, erosional scarps and road cuts all produce sharp gradient maxima. A magnetic gradient maximum also sits over the *edge of the magnetised body*, not over the fault plane, so the crest can be systematically offset from the trace.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcap2p0-g0p15-20261023-2.predicted_sign_and_size: MODEL:±0.008 (MODEL, range [-0.008,+0.008]). Derivation: one converted dot (zero credit -> credit c~2.5, best-weight 0.8, newly covering c of |G|) is worth [(2.5)(1+0.8*0.278) - 0.278(-1.66)]/D ~ 1.5e-4 at D~19,900, a denominator calibrated from the lineage's own measured 2.8e-6 per zero-credit dot. With 2660 movers the sign of the live change is therefore decided by whether the net conversion rate is above or below zero. The quoted range is about +-2 sigma of a pure-relocation null, sigma(dDTI) ~ 1.22*sigma_c*sqrt(n_movers)/D with sigma_c ~ 1.5 kernel units per moved dot (=> ~0.009); the model cannot resolve a sign below 0.01, so these are two-sided ranges, not gains.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcap2p0-g0p15-20261023-2.falsifier: If g=0.05 (52% of dots relocate by ~1 px) lands more than 0.01 BELOW g=0.15 and R0, the edge maxima are worse position estimators than the parent's own lineaments and the SNAP hypothesis is rejected for this region. If g=0.15 gains >0.01 while g=0.05 loses >0.01, only the clearly-mispositioned dots are correctable and later axes must keep a strict evidence threshold. A monotone increase with dose supports composing SNAP onto the best PRUNE rung.
h33-h33-2-b2-SNAPcap2p0-g0p15-20261023-2.decision_rule: Live change under 0.01 is no evidence. Receipts only; never a PROXY.
